title: Planning invariant test decomposition
description: Objective: split the oversized cross-aggregate invariant test by deterministic fixture and driver responsibility while preserving the full property corpus. Deliverable: planning-invariant-fixtures.ts owns hashes, witnesses, seeded generators, perturbation, commands, and traces; planning-invariant-drivers.ts owns valid-state drivers/seed pools; planning-invariants.test.ts retains the invariant assertions. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6. NOT in scope: production changes, seed/count reduction, weaker equality/freezing assertions, or new lifecycle policy. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/planning-invariants.test.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-invariant-fixtures.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-invariant-drivers.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: The same deterministic seed set, command traces, digest perturbations, multi-node cases, lifecycle ranks, and terminal-state corpus are exercised.
Every existing invariant assertion remains and still proves determinism, monotonic lifecycle, exact-hash refusal, zero state change, deep freezing, successor isolation, and terminal graph authority.
All three files are <=250 physical lines and support modules contain no Vitest registration or production exports.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.
